usedFor: tawk.to handles live chat, and Google Docs stores each “New Chat Transcript Arrives” through “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Chat Transcript Arrives” in tawk.to, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Every saved transcript is written into a doc, so chat history is readable without opening tawk.to.

watchOut: “Chat Ends” and “New Chat Transcript Arrives” can both fire for one chat, so connect only one.
